title: Manifolds and Curvature
description: Spaces that look flat close up but bend overall, in any number of dimensions. Their total curvature is fixed by their topology (Gauss-Bonnet); string theory asks which six-dimensional one the universe hides.

puzzle.goal: A closed surface has g handles. Write its total curvature K, the curvature added up over the whole surface.
puzzle.name: Gauss-Bonnet
puzzle.ask: Find K for g = 0 (a sphere of any size).
puzzle.method: Total curvature is 2π times the Euler characteristic, which is 2 − 2g: a sphere of any size has 4π.
